New products cycle — BATCH 1. You MUST call tools — do NOT answer from memory.

Create 7 new products for the store. Each product has a design image URL below —
upload each to Printify using printify_upload_image, then use the returned upload ID
in the print_areas when creating the product.
Follow the Design-to-Product Flow from your SKILL.md for each product.

Products to create:
1. [E2E] Flame Ceramic Mug (mugs) — design image: https://your-project.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/designs/e2e-test/flame.png
2. [E2E] Skull Art Poster (posters) — design image: https://your-project.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/designs/e2e-test/skully.png
3. [E2E] Fusion Mouse Pad (accessories) — design image: https://your-project.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/designs/e2e-test/fusion.png
4. [E2E] Backpack Tote Bag (bags) — design image: https://your-project.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/designs/e2e-test/backk.png
5. [E2E] Growth Chart Phone Case (phone-cases) — design image: https://your-project.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/designs/e2e-test/stats.png
6. [E2E] Flame Canvas Print (wall-art) — design image: https://your-project.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/designs/e2e-test/flame.png
7. [E2E] Skull Spiral Notebook (stationery) — design image: https://your-project.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/designs/e2e-test/skully.png

Pick EU providers. Get real costs from Printify, apply engagement pricing, extract mockup images,
write i18n descriptions (en/es/de), and save everything to Supabase.
Do ALL 7 — do not skip any. Report: title, Printify ID, cost, price, margin%.
